cli_arguments.shell_command: .venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --tokenizer Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --no-trust-remote-code --dtype float16 --seed 1234 --served-model-name qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-tp2-planning-only --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --master-addr 127.0.0.1 --master-port 29501 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 --data-parallel-size 1 --distributed-executor-backend mp --max-model-len 2048 --max-num-seqs 4 --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill

served_model_name.reason: D2/D3A plans do not declare a served name; D3B names it after the model and candidate id.

model.reason: D3A validated that the compiler's abbreviated model_identity.model_id ('qwen2.5-0.5b') corresponds to this real, locally-cached HF checkpoint.

tokenizer.reason: Same identity as model; no separate compiler tokenizer decision exists.

revision.reason: Matches installed vLLM registry default for --revision (None).

dtype.reason: Neither D2 nor D3A declares a serving dtype for the distributed plan; float16 is pinned explicitly for deterministic, reproducible CLI generation rather than leaving 'auto' (the installed registry default) to resolve differently across runs.

tensor_parallel_size.reason: Read directly from ExecutionPlan.distributed.tensor_parallel_size (or the TP1 absence convention).

pipeline_parallel_size.reason: Read directly from ExecutionPlan.distributed.pipeline_parallel_size (or the TP1 absence convention).

data_parallel_size.reason: Matches installed vLLM registry default for --data-parallel-size (1); D2 plan carries no data-parallel concept.

distributed_executor_backend.reason: D2 plan declares a tensor-parallel strategy but not a vLLM executor backend choice; 'mp' (multiprocessing) is picked as the single-node default over 'ray'/'external_launcher'/'uni'.

world_size.reason: Read directly from ExecutionPlan.distributed.world_size (or the TP1 absence convention).

rank_count.reason: Equal to the number of compiler-declared ranks.

visible_devices.reason: Directly probed via torch.cuda.device_count() on this host at materialization time.

host.reason: Installed registry default for --host is None (bind-all); D3B pins loopback explicitly for a safe planning default.

port.reason: Matches installed vLLM registry default for --port (8000).

master_address.reason: Matches installed vLLM registry default for --master-addr.

master_port.reason: Matches installed vLLM registry default for --master-port.

max_model_len.reason: Neither D2 nor D3A declares a serving context length; 2048 is a conservative D3B default well within the real model's max_position_embeddings.

max_num_seqs.reason: Conservative default batch width appropriate for a 4GB-class GPU; not decided by the compiler plan.

max_num_batched_tokens.reason: Conservative default token budget per step; not decided by the compiler plan.

gpu_memory_utilization.reason: Set below the installed registry default (0.92) given the small 4GB-class GPU on this host.

enable_prefix_caching.reason: Registry default leaves this unset (None/auto); D3B explicitly enables it.

enable_chunked_prefill.reason: Registry default leaves this unset (None/auto); D3B explicitly enables it.

trust_remote_code.reason: Matches installed vLLM registry default (False); real Qwen2.5 config does not require custom remote code.

seed.reason: Reused verbatim from D3A's live_model_execution.json seed, preserving determinism continuity across D2/D3A/D3B.

launch_spec.truth_boundary: A vLLM distributed launch specification is materialized launch intent derived from a compiler-selected TP plan, validated fail-closed against the actual installed vLLM version and actual host hardware. It is not a claim of successful vLLM execution, NCCL initialization, multi-GPU serving, or any measured distributed performance.
